data: Skeleton entry for /fleet (PRD-012 v0.2 / Phase A scaffold). Builder + agency + first-flight per public sources. Specs and gallery TBD in later phases.
Soyuz T-2 (1980-06-05) · Malyshev + Aksyonov — first crewed flight of the Soyuz-T variant; short validation visit to Salyut 6 (4 days)
Soyuz T-3 (1980-11-27) · Kizim + Makarov + Strekalov — first three-person Soyuz crew since 1971 (T-series restored full crew capacity)
Soyuz T-5 (1982-05-13) · Berezovoy + Lebedev — Salyut 7 first crew; 211 days (longest at the time)
Soyuz T-7 (1982-08-19) · Popov + Serebrov + Savitskaya — Svetlana Savitskaya: second woman in space (19 years after Tereshkova)
Soyuz T-13 (1985-06-06) · Dzhanibekov + Savinykh — rescued the disabled Salyut 7 station; only Soviet salvage spaceflight, 110 days
Soyuz T-15 (1986-03-13) · Kizim + Solovyov — last Soyuz T; first crew to dock with both Mir and Salyut 7 in one flight

La Soyuz del 1979–1986, dell'era Salyut, con la capacità di tre cosmonauti ripristinata dopo la fatale decompressione della Soyuz 11. Avionica modernizzata e propulsione ipergolica; il ponte tra la 7K-OK originale e la lunga linea TM/TMA/MS.
Analogo atmosferico di Buran — equivalente dell'Enterprise della NASA. Quattro motori a reazione, 24 test 1985-88, mai in orbita
